[RFCS.19.8] **A recording that ends at its last complete atom is in progress
or crash-truncated, not corrupt.** A reader must not treat a `Stream` that reaches
EOF ([RFCS.19.2]) as an integrity failure: the recording is complete as far as
it goes, and the reader recovers it to the last complete atom.

**The recovery path is the incremental reader** ([RFCS.19.2]). This is a property
of the container, so it must not depend on which entry point a caller reached
for; naming the path is what keeps that true while a whole-buffer reader is still
permitted to refuse a short tail. A conforming implementation must therefore
offer an incremental path capable of recovering a crash-truncated recording.
Without one, the recovery this clause promises has no path that delivers it.
